Hi all —

Thanks for flagging — below are suggested edits and policy notes we should include in the offer wording and onboarding notes. I’ve numbered them so we can reference quickly when we update the PDF/DocuSign: 

1) Start date vs payroll effective date (recommended language): 
   "The candidate's official start date will be as agreed in this offer. Payroll and benefits coverage will be effective on the payroll period that includes the official start date unless otherwise agreed in writing by Redwood's People Operations."
   - Operational note: We can agree to a delayed payroll effective date but benefits eligibility (medical/dental/401k) will align to payroll enrollment windows; delaying payroll may delay benefits effective dates.

2) Relocation stipend (recommended schedule): 
   "Relocation stipend of $7,500 will be paid in two installments: 50% on the first payroll after the official start date and 50% 30 calendar days after the official start date, subject to successful completion of the background check."

3) Signing bonus: Keep $20,000 but clarify repayment clause:  pro rata repayment if employment ends within 12 months. Payment to be processed in the first payroll after 60 days of employment to allow final tax reconciliation.

4) Immigration sponsorship: 
   "Redwood will initiate employer sponsorship upon receipt of a signed offer and required documentation. Timeline estimates are provided for planning only; Redwood cannot guarantee immigration approvals or exact timing. Employee acknowledges that onboarding, relocation payments, and remote work arrangements may be contingent on immigration status and background verification."
   - Practical note: For H-4 EAD holders we can support remote onboarding prior to approval but we prefer official start once work authorization is verified to avoid payroll complications.

5) Background check clause (must be present): 
   "This offer is contingent upon successful completion of background checks and verification of employment eligibility."

6) Remote onboarding and equipment: Add a short paragraph allowing temporary remote onboarding and equipment shipping prior to payroll with manager approval; costs will be reconciled in payroll.

7) Equity vesting: Clarify that the vesting commencement date will be the official start date.

If everyone is okay with the above language, I’ll prepare a redline to the PDF and update the DocuSign; please note HR prefers not to make payroll exceptions that create retroactive benefits enrollment.

Neha
